name: Alex Example
headline: Principal Data and AI Engineer | Python, GCP, AWS and LLMs

sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: Hands-on data and AI engineer with fifteen years of delivery, from industrial control software to cloud data platforms and production LLM features. Builds event-driven pipelines, ML services and retrieval-augmented assistants in Python on GCP and AWS, and has led small engineering teams without leaving the code.

roles.title: Principal Engineer
roles.blurb: Consultancy building AI features for mid-sized retailers and insurers.
roles.tech: Python, FastAPI, Vertex AI, Claude, pgvector, Cloud Run, Terraform
bullets: Built a claims-triage assistant using retrieval over policy documents and a tool-using agent; adopted by two client teams and cut first-response time by roughly a third.
Designed an evaluation harness (labelled cases, regression gates in CI) so prompt and model changes ship with measured quality instead of spot checks.
Set up the delivery template used on every engagement: typed Python, OpenAPI-first services, IaC and least-privilege service accounts.

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.blurb: Analytics platform provider for logistics companies.
roles.tech: Python, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, dbt, Looker
bullets: Managed a team of six engineers that moved nightly batch reporting to streaming ingestion; data was available within minutes instead of the next morning.
Introduced data contracts and automated quality checks, reducing customer-reported data issues by about half over a year.
Kept roughly a third of my time on hands-on work: pipeline code reviews, on-call and performance tuning.

roles.title: Head of Data
roles.tech: Python, AWS Glue, Lambda, Redshift, PySpark, Metabase
bullets: Owned ingestion, modelling and reporting for product and commercial teams, with a team of three.
Built a recommendation model for course suggestions that lifted enrolments from the home page by several percentage points in an A/B test.
Detected and filtered automated sign-ups that were inflating engagement metrics, restoring trust in the weekly numbers.

roles.title: Analytics Lead
bullets: Built a text-classification pipeline that tagged incoming research documents by topic, replacing a manual triage step.
Rebuilt the scraping and ingestion jobs for parallel execution, increasing daily throughput several-fold on the same budget.

roles.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Wrote reconciliation and fraud-signal pipelines processing millions of transactions a day.
Added automated tests and deployment pipelines to a previously manual release process.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed and verified control software for water-treatment equipment, including simulation tools that reduced on-site commissioning time.

sections.title: Education
items: Master of Data Science, an Australian university
Bachelor of Engineering (Mechatronics), an Australian university

sections.title: Skills
items: AI and ML: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agents and tool use, evaluation, scikit-learn, PyTorch
Data engineering: Python, SQL, PySpark, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, dbt, Airflow, streaming and batch pipelines
Cloud and delivery: GCP, AWS, Cloud Run, Lambda, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, OpenAPI
